the development and validation of a novel HF transformer design for TIPS.
the design, measurement and synthesis of a 10 kHz HF transformer for a three-phase TIPS application.
the design of high frequency transformer for three-phase TIPS, which is an emerging technology in power electronics.

we have developed the first high power, 3-phase HF transformer with 10kHz switching frequency for DAB stage of a TIPS application.

a HF transformer can be designed to achieve a high power rating, while maintaining a small footprint and low cost.
